mapper.sql: select r.*, u1.nickname as reporter_name, u2.nickname as assignee_name from rescue r left join `user` u1 on r.reporter_id = u1.id left join `user` u2 on r.assignee_id = u2.id
mapper.insert: insert into rescue (title, description, images, location, contact, status, reporter_id, create_time) values (#{title}, #{description}, #{images}, #{location}, #{contact}, #{status}, #{reporterId}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: where r.reporter_id = #{reporterId} order by r.create_time desc
mapper.update: update rescue set status = #{status} where id = #{id}
update rescue set assignee_id = #{assigneeId}, status = #{status} where id = #{id}
